paper.title: Gaia Data Release 3: Chemical cartography of the Milky Way

selection.rule: Across four fixed source_id sky bands, collect 400 ascending orbital candidates per band and rule profile; then take the first 8 ascending source_id values in the paper's High sample and the first 8 in Medium-but-not-High.

profiles.label: Cold rotating / metal-rich rule profile
profiles.rule: vphi >= 180 km/s; eccentricity <= 0.2; zmax <= 0.5 kpc; [M/H] >= -0.5 dex

profiles.label: Alpha-raised intermediate-orbit rule profile
profiles.candidatePredicate: vphi_med >= 100 AND vphi_med < 200 AND ecc_med > 0.2 AND ecc_med < 0.6 AND zmax_med > 0.5 AND zmax_med < 3
profiles.rule: 100 <= vphi < 200 km/s; 0.2 < eccentricity < 0.6; 0.5 < zmax < 3 kpc; -1 <= [M/H] < -0.3 dex; [alpha/Fe] >= 0.15 dex
interpretations: alpha-raised dynamically warm disc-like present-day pattern

profiles.label: Radial metal-poor rule profile
profiles.rule: vphi >= 0 km/s; eccentricity >= 0.7; zmax >= 3 kpc; [M/H] <= -0.8 dex
interpretations: compatible with more than one formation channel

profiles.label: Counter-rotating metal-poor rule profile
interpretations: compatible with accretion-related interpretations, but not proof of origin

qualityDefinitions.medium: Appendix B General exclusions plus Teff/logg/uncertainty limits and GSP-Spec flag positions 1-6 <=1, 7 <=3, 8 <=2, 13 <=1.
qualityDefinitions.high: Appendix B Teff/logg limits and GSP-Spec flag positions 1-7 =0, 8 <=2, 9-12 =0, 13 <=1.
